pictures.scene: Johan Christian Dahl, An Eruption of Vesuvius — the lava running down the mountain and the smoke going up off the red crater, He looks on the earth and it trembles, He touches the mountains and they smolder
pictures.name: pd_dahl_beeft

pictures.scene: Orazio Gentileschi, Saint Cecilia and an Angel — the saint with her hands on the organ keys and the angel holding the music open for her, I will sing to the LORD all my life, I will sing praise to my God while I have my being
pictures.name: pd_gentileschi_zingen

pictures.scene: Gerrit Dou, An Old Woman Reading the Bible — the old woman bent close over the great open book with her hands on the page, may my meditation be pleasing to Him, for I rejoice in the LORD
pictures.name: pd_dou_overdenking

pictures.scene: Mariotto Albertinelli, The Visitation — Mary and Elizabeth meeting under the arch and holding one another as the Magnificat begins, may sinners vanish from the earth, and the wicked be no more
pictures.name: pd_albertinelli_verblijd

pictures.scene: Fra Angelico, The Coronation of the Virgin — the whole court of heaven with the trumpets and the lutes and the saints kneeling before the throne, bless the LORD O my soul, Hallelujah
pictures.name: pd_angelico_halleluja

lines.text: I will sing to the LORD all my life;
I will sing praise to my God while I have my being.
May my meditation be pleasing to Him,
for I rejoice in the LORD.
May sinners vanish from the earth
and the wicked be no more.
Bless the LORD, O my soul.
